dense_parent.note: fused affine2 kernels consume packed 2-bit codes in-register; no parent W is written

why_affine2_g64_was_slower.why: Q4 geo_tpr64 uses compile-time group 64 so col/64 is a shift. The affine2 G0 path previously took group_size as a bind-time parameter, putting a non-constant integer divide on every 8-wide tile. That is a kernel problem, not a property of 2-bit. The production affine2 geo kernel now specializes 32 vs 64 to shifts. The extra bias term (w = q*scale + bias) remains; it is the same per element at g32 and g64. On the gate shape, runtime-div was 1.37x the specialized g64 body.
